title: RBI monetary/prudential updates cluster
summary: **A)** Counterparty Credit Risk: equity add-ons 6%/8%/10% by maturity band; QCCP trade exposure risk weight 2%

items: **A)** Counterparty Credit Risk: equity add-ons 6%/8%/10% by maturity band; QCCP trade exposure risk weight 2%
**B)** Capital market exposure rules postponed 3 months — new deadline **July 1, 2026** (was April 1)
**C)** ECB filings: authorised dealers submit ECB returns within **7 calendar days**, effective April 1, 2026 (earlier: no fixed deadline)
**D)** WMA limit, Govt of India, **H1 FY27 (Apr-Sep 2026): ₹2,50,000 crore**; fresh market-loan floatation trigger at 75% utilisation; WMA rate = repo, overdraft = repo+2%
**E)** FX position cap: net rupee open position (NOP-INR) capped **$100 million/day**, compliance by 10 April 2026

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → WMA limit H1 FY27 = ₹2,50,000 crore; don't confuse with the $100mn FX cap.
